caribbean.headline: Heavy Rain and Choppy Seas Impact Barbados
caribbean.paragraph: Barbados is experiencing heavy rain with a 100% rain probability, easterly winds near 13 kt, and seas to 4.1 ft with an 8 s ESE swell. I expect reduced visibility and operational impacts at Bridgetown and advise caution for vessels bound for Fort-de-France, where winds are about 12 kt and similar short-period seas persist.

mediterranean.headline: Choppy Seas Around Mykonos with Moderate NNE Swell
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing northeasterly winds up to 20 kt, seas to 5.2 ft and a dominant NNE swell with a 6 s period, and less than 10% rain probability. I advise captains and port operators to expect locally choppy conditions and reduced passenger comfort; Marseille is the runner-up with southeasterly winds near 18 kt and generally lower seas.
